Genesis client API for shared-memory setup, init, polling, and pollfd access.

# Purpose
`fd_genesis_client.h` defines the public interface for a genesis client that uses shared memory and network polling. It declares the opaque `fd_genesis_client_t` type, alignment and footprint query functions, and lifecycle functions such as [`fd_genesis_client_new`](<#fd_genesis_client_new>), [`fd_genesis_client_join`](<#fd_genesis_client_join>), and [`fd_genesis_client_init`](<#fd_genesis_client_init>). The header also declares [`fd_genesis_client_poll`](<#fd_genesis_client_poll>) for receiving data from configured servers and [`fd_genesis_client_get_pollfds`](<#fd_genesis_client_get_pollfds>) for access to the underlying `pollfd` array. The file includes the network header definitions needed for `fd_ip4_port_t` and `struct pollfd`, and it defines the `FD_GENESIS_CLIENT_MAGIC` and `FD_GENESIS_CLIENT_ALIGN` constants used by the implementation.
